description: SQL query for finding overdue reservations
content:
SELECT r.id, r.patron_id, r.due_date
FROM reservations r
JOIN patrons p ON p.id = r.patron_id
WHERE r.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
  AND r.returned_at IS NULL
ORDER BY r.due_date ASC;

description: Step-by-step procedure for rotating API keys
content:
API key rotation procedure:
1. Generate new key in the admin console (Settings > API Keys > Generate)
2. Update the key in vault: vault kv put secret/api-keys/catalog-sync key=NEW_KEY
3. Restart the catalog-sync service: systemctl restart catalog-sync
4. Verify connectivity: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer NEW_KEY' https://api.example.com/health
5. Revoke the old key in admin console
6. Update the rotation log in Confluence

Branch naming conventions:
- feature/TICKET-123-short-description
- bugfix/TICKET-456-what-is-fixed
- hotfix/TICKET-789-critical-issue
- release/v1.2.3

Always use lowercase. Ticket prefix is mandatory for feature and bugfix branches. Hotfix branches go directly to main after review.

description: Architecture decision about event sourcing approach
content:
We evaluated three approaches for the catalog sync pipeline:

1. Polling: Simple but introduces latency (up to 60s). No ordering guarantees across partitions.

2. Webhooks: Low latency but requires public endpoint. Retry semantics are provider-dependent.

3. Event stream (chosen): Kafka consumer group with exactly-once semantics. Handles backpressure natively. Partition key = catalog_id ensures ordering per catalog.

The tradeoff is operational complexity (Kafka cluster maintenance) but we already run Kafka for the notification pipeline so incremental cost is low.

description: Known error pattern and its resolution
content:
When you see 'SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked' in the sync service logs, it means two workers grabbed the same partition. Resolution:
1. Check which workers are active: SELECT * FROM worker_leases WHERE expires_at > NOW();
2. Kill the stale worker (the one with older claimed_at)
3. The surviving worker will resume from its last checkpoint automatically

Root cause: lease expiry is set to 30s but GC pauses can exceed that under memory pressure. We should increase to 60s (tracked in backlog).
